audit_items.proof_trace: Anti-equivocation cache is updated at line 206 AFTER broadcast attempt (line 201), but broadcast errors are only logged (line 202) without preventing cache update. BroadcastDataColumnSidecar spawns async goroutine (broadcaster.go:333) that can fail silently, creating state divergence where cache marks column as published despite broadcast failure.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker isolates victim node from data column subnet peers via network partitioning. Victim reconstructs custody columns and attempts broadcast, which fails due to no available peers. Cache incorrectly marks column as published, preventing retry. Network lacks column from this custody holder, breaking data availability.
